t: Various machines in the RFTools tech mods support modules. These are items that can be inserted in the machine to modify or provide functionalities. In most cases (when a machine supports modules) you can just right click with the module on the machine to insert it
RFTools 技术类模组中的多种机器都支持模块。这些是可以插入机器中以修改或提供功能的物品。在大多数情况下（当机器支持模块时），你只需拿着模块对机器右键即可将其插入。
